question: After replacing both actual tool working lengths with120 mm and recertifying every action, do frozen policies retain a useful complete sequence, stop despite positive attainable nominal value, or stop appropriately under this geometric objective?
motivation: The preserved descriptor-only experiment changed RL256 STOP preference to99.3915%, but did not recertify longer physical tools. This diagnostic resolves that limitation before interpreting STOP behavior.
scope: Full-information tiny generated tool-distribution diagnostic and end-to-end interface integration; NOT the primary limited-information unseen-patient experiment.
physical_intervention: Construct new ToolGeometry instances, then rebuild nominal native tasks and certified state-dependent action inventories. Never patch observation descriptors or reuse old action IDs/certificates.

algorithms.SEARCH: existing observed_beam_search on permitted nominal estimates
algorithms.IL: masked deterministic argmax of fixed BC256
algorithms.RL: masked deterministic argmax of fixed scratch REINFORCE256
algorithms.HYBRID: same observed_beam_search and nominal reward, using fixed RL256 only to order all legal expansions; critic value ignored

search_strength: At most12 declared tool-cell slots per state and horizon2 imply at most156 nonSTOP transition evaluations and12 first-layer survivors. The256-call/beam16 baseline can complete this finite search; actual cap/pruning flags must confirm completion before any optimality statement.

whole_run_proposed_limits.rss_scope: existing supervisor samples worker process; native execution is single-process threads

IL.teacher: five audited states from complete nominal search on the original generated fixture; inherited search/demonstration generation costs remain attributable

common_training_lineage.permission_basis: Prior authorized generated opening experiments under the user's simulator-generated research experience permission; no new fit is proposed.

commit_before_evaluation: All four method slots finish as complete, abstained, or failed; each complete full physical strategy and resulting state is durably saved, then the entire planning suite is sealed. Only the separate evaluator receives a reference loader. Partial failures retain null outcomes and remain in the denominator.
independent_evaluation: Replay committed actions using the existing native geometry checker and independent unique-cell/reward accounting. The reference is the original generated target, not patient-specific withheld anatomy. No new policy or search decision is requested during scoring.
primary_readouts: complete tool path and tool changes
search completeness and modeled regret relative to complete search
secondary_readouts: actor STOP-minus-best-movement score at every actually visited state
same initial permitted-observation identity within each condition
actual model transitions, actor forwards and native previews
inherited training costs and separate preparation/export/evaluation work
claim_limits: No rich-training advantage is established by two policies fitted on one generated fixture.
This is not acquired-anatomy generalization, clinical STOP correctness, or physical tissue validation.
Long-tool feasibility outside the source field of view remains unassessed and explicitly recorded by the existing strategy contract.
Search and hybrid may equal or outperform pure policies; that result will be preserved.
Single ordered timings do not establish deployment efficiency.
